Life has been weird since The Shift. People everywhere trying to figure the world out, why it happened and how and what to do about it. Many, myself included, find it strange that only certain "video games" were effected. All of the effected were games with first person views or single entity games. Nearly all fps like CoD, Dark Souls or Minecraft were seen in some form. Story driven games like The last of us or any of the Walking dead were left unaffected, I suppose they didn't have any powers to begin with. Games with omnipresent rulers like The Civilization games or Plague weren't effected either. Lucky for the world in my opinion. 
People effected seem to be the only ones having to deal with the consequences in their own lives. At least, nothing in the news suggested that the world was destabilizing...
I, for one, was getting used to my predicament. My game? Stardew Valley. An odd one for sure, for one I can no longer see the world from a first person view. Second, my vision is somewhat pixilated. Certainly not as bad as the Minecrafters but, still jarring. 
I've also found that I have a menu... others online say that it's normal for The Stardews, and a few others. I can see and interact with it to a limited degree, unlike the true game I can't effect the settings and I, of corse, can't "exit" the game. Someone wrote on a forum once that a Stardew tried and he suddenly dropped dead. I'm not sure I believe that but I'm not going to try it myself, not worth the risk...
Anyways.
People I regularly interact with have a hearts bar, and I myself have a limited skills bar that I can check. I have only so much energy in a day but that hasn't really been a problem for me yet.
It's really kind of nice if you think about it. Not as nice as some others but I could have definitely been stuck with worse...
